name: Blobbelnoppel
storyline: Blobithan and his friends Clobbler and Timmy are enjoying a normal lunch at school, when The King, an evil dictator from The Islands, breaks down their walls and demands control of the school, along with the entirety of Mainland Grouterplort. After discussing what to do, they all decide to go after The King and save their country from his rule. Partnering up with the bubbly conductor Mr. Schwarmahort and the miserable train engineer Graylen, they use the Grouterplort Express, a flying train, to fly up to the floating islands and climb their way up. Along the way, they meet Topithort, a bright, fancy looking student that went to their school. With Topithort joining the gang on their mission, they go to each island one by one, dismantling The King's operations, taking down progressively tougher foes, and helping out the citizens of Upper Grouterplort along the way.
summary: BLOBBELNOPPEL is a story-driven dungeon crawler made in RPG Maker. Blobithan, a regular high school freshman, is forced on the run by an evil dictator dressed like a king from the medieval times invading his home country of Grouterplort. Joined by his friends Clobbler, Timmy, and Topithort, Blobithan must fight his way up mysterious floating islands to get to The King's castle, dismantling branches of his elaborate operation along the way.
